name: Pranav U S

education.degree: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

points: Built an OCR pipeline using PyMuPDF, Tesseract and EasyOCR to extract text from PDFs, images and scanned documents.
Developed a RAG-based document querying system using Haystack and OpenLLaMA.
Built a scalable document processing service supporting multiple file formats and OCR workflows.

projects.name: Crowd-Aware Evacuation Planner (capstone, team project)
projects.text: Built a seeded evacuation simulator and five routing methods; a look-ahead capacity-booking planner cut last-out time by up to 36% against shortest-safe-path, significant in 8 of 10 campus scenarios over 2,766 runs. Trained a hybrid physics-plus-LightGBM crossing-time model on 784,014 simulated crossings, halving held-out error (4.76 s to 2.41 s), and calibrated the simulator on real Juelich crowd data. Transferred the method to a 100-bed hospital graph, with faster evacuation in 6 of 6 scenarios.

projects.name: Payment Tracker
projects.stack: Next.js 15 · React 19 · TypeScript · MongoDB Atlas · Better Auth · Vercel
projects.text: Built and deployed a personal finance app covering recurring payments, cash flow, loans and investments. Designed an exactly-once payment event pipeline on MongoDB without a message queue, using unique event indexes, leases, transactions, idempotency keys and retries with backoff, so repeat deliveries, double clicks and crashes record a payment once. Wrote 123 unit and 47 integration tests against a real MongoDB replica set.

projects.name: Cadence — Productivity Platform
projects.stack: React 19 · Node.js · Express 5 · MongoDB Atlas · JWT · Vercel
projects.text: Built and deployed a full-stack productivity app with routines on 1–20 day cycles, tasks, goals, a calendar and a focus timer, plus a website-blocker Chrome extension. Designed a nine-theme system on one component tree with CSS design tokens, added two-way iCal calendar sync, and wrote a natural-language quick-add parser with unit tests.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Research Assistant
projects.stack: Python · Claude API · Tavily · Streamlit · Plotly
projects.text: Architected a multi-agent research assistant comparing Sequential, Shared-Memory (Blackboard) and Critic Feedback orchestration for automated research and report generation. Implemented specialized agents and an LLM-as-judge evaluation measuring report quality, factual accuracy and hallucination rate, with a provider layer that also runs on Groq or a local Ollama model.
